name: firmwareUpToDate
definition: The installed PAN-OS version is at or above the newest release listed for the same feature train (major.minor), hotfixes included. This tool does not read the list of available releases (the only call that returns it is the request system software check command, which is not read-only), so the key is Not evaluated until a read-only source exists.
population: the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The installed version and a release list showing no newer release in the same feature train. This tool does not read the release list (no read-only call returns it), so the key is Not evaluated.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: show system info reply (result/system/sw-version) is from vendor examples, UNVERIFIED on a real device. No read-only config or show call lists the available releases, so the list is absent and the key is Not evaluated. If a body does carry a softwareUpdates result (result/sw-updates/entry/version, or under sw-updates/versions) the comparison still runs; a train that is end of life reads as current if nothing newer is listed.
